title: Critical tribes dimension diverges
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s_w$ be the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ such that $1-(1-2^{-w})^{s_w}\le 1/2$, and set $d_w=s_w w$. As $w$ tends to infinity, $d_w$ tends to infinity.
